create_kosmos2_5_image_processor: create a Kosmos2_5ImageProcessor instance with custom patch_size and max_patches parameters
run_extract_flattened_patches: run extract_flattened_patches to extract flattened patches from an image tensor with max_patches and patch_size constraints
run_normalize_image: run normalize to compute per-image mean and std then normalize an image tensor using TorchvisionBackend
run_preprocess_images: run preprocess to group images by shape, normalize, extract patches, and return flattened_patches with attention_mask and dimensions
review_torch_extract_patches: review the torch_extract_patches utility function that extracts non-overlapping patches from a batch of image tensors
